intents.title: Build DALEOBANKS as one layered global institution
intents.statement: DALEOBANKS is one global lifestyle brand and AI-assisted public institution whose media, education, entertainment, community, commerce, distribution, collaboration, opportunity discovery, and aspiration acceleration are layers of one company.
intents.source: DALEOBANKS Complete Master Implementation Prompt and PR #65 founder-intent lineage
intents.source_location: User master prompt sections 2 and 83; PR #65 docs/DALEOBANKS_MEDIA_BRAND_ARCHITECTURE.md sections 1-3
intents.intended_outcome: Create a profitable, durable public institution that increases participant capability and finances progressively more ambitious UNIIMENTE development.
intents.rationale: The founder explicitly rejects reducing DALEOBANKS to an X bot or a documentation exercise and defines the layers as one coherent company.
intents.next_review_trigger: When the first source-to-shadow loop is validated and the next external evidence pilot is selected.
unresolved_questions: Which first owned-audience offer will receive explicit launch authority?

intents.title: Operate one truthful identity through legitimate surfaces
intents.statement: Every account, language, channel, community, and product must be a traceable DALEOBANKS surface; no fake people, sockpuppets, impersonation, ban evasion, astroturfing, or manufactured consensus.
intents.intended_outcome: Grow a coherent global brand without deceptive identity or inauthentic influence operations.
intents.rationale: Identity truth is a stated fixed boundary and is already partially enforced by the historical lane policy.
intents.next_review_trigger: Before any account can transition from SHADOW to ACTIVE.

intents.title: Keep DALEOBANKS subordinate to founder-authorized UNIIMENTE governance
intents.statement: Alfonso remains the constitutional human authority; DALEOBANKS may become operationally independent inside a bounded mandate but may not create a parallel constitution, identity root, legal principal, consequence gate, treasury, terminal mission, or authority-expansion power.
intents.source: DALEOBANKS Complete Master Implementation Prompt and PR #65
intents.source_location: User master prompt sections 4, 5, and 52; PR #65 docs/DALEOBANKS_MEDIA_BRAND_ARCHITECTURE.md section 2
intents.intended_outcome: Enable high routine autonomy without machine sovereignty or duplicated constitutional ownership.
intents.rationale: This boundary reconciles the desired operating independence with explicit founder control and one root consequence architecture.
intents.next_review_trigger: Any proposal to widen standing authority or add a new consequential connector.
unresolved_questions: The external Golden Kernel standing-authority contract is not present in this repository.

intents.title: Fail external effects toward silence and evidence
intents.statement: Publishing, money movement, sensitive outreach, legal commitments, regulated actions, settlement, and authority expansion require current standing authority or explicit founder authorization; failures degrade to pause, draft-only, or read-only while preserving evidence.
intents.source_location: Opening scope boundary and sections 43-47, 64-66, and 87
intents.intended_outcome: Prevent unauthorized external consequences while allowing safe research, drafting, and shadow validation.
intents.rationale: The current implementation already has a kill switch and exact capability grants; the Phase 0 loop must narrow those controls rather than bypass them.
intents.next_review_trigger: Before the first authorized production publication or external commercial experiment.

intents.title: Converge repository truth before expansion
intents.statement: Inventory current mechanisms, ownership, adapters, external effects, stores, schedulers, pipelines, mocks, and tests; preserve useful history and classify rather than delete it.
intents.source_location: User master prompt sections 51, 52, 69, 70, and Phase 0 in section 71
intents.intended_outcome: Create a comprehensible substrate that reuses canonical mechanisms and exposes unresolved ownership or simulation boundaries.
intents.rationale: Expansion without repository convergence risks duplicate governance, hidden effects, and a second architecture.
intents.next_review_trigger: Any newly discovered effect path, canonical owner, or conflicting active branch.
unresolved_questions: No official account or credential can be inferred from public repository data.

intents.title: Build one evidence-bound multilingual flagship loop
intents.statement: One researched thesis must carry source provenance, evidence status, counterargument, uncertainty, risk review, local cultural expression, platform adaptation, authority evaluation, a shadow or authorized receipt, and outcome learning without factual drift.
intents.source: DALEOBANKS Complete Master Implementation Prompt and PR #65
intents.source_location: User master prompt sections 12, 15-18, and Phase 1 in section 71; PR #65 multilingual publishing doctrine
intents.intended_outcome: Turn one canonical evidence base into locally natural artifacts with truthful, attributable shadow receipts before production authority exists.
intents.rationale: A vertical slice proves integration and makes future platform and language expansion cheaper than adding disconnected components.
intents.next_review_trigger: After a founder-declared SHADOW account and real source packet complete the loop.
unresolved_questions: No live account, credential, or production publication authority is registered.

intents.title: Preserve the 8 PM daily high-signal news product
intents.statement: The daily edition must distinguish reporting from opinion and cover what happened, why it matters, what most people miss, who benefits, who is exposed, what changes, and what to watch next, with the established 8:00 PM editorial time preserved.
intents.intended_outcome: Produce a distinctive evening intelligence product rather than generic headline repetition.
intents.rationale: The structured content contract and 20:00 metadata are executable now; scheduler activation remains gated and intentionally absent.
intents.next_review_trigger: When a timezone, official source feed, account, and publication mandate are declared.
unresolved_questions: The founder has not declared the canonical timezone for 8:00 PM.

intents.title: Measure capability and commercial reality instead of volume
intents.statement: Followers, impressions, likes, and generated volume are not closure; success requires verified advancement actions, paying customers, reconciled economics, owned distribution, and one stage-appropriate Single Bottleneck Metric.
intents.intended_outcome: Make external acceptance, participant progress, and reconciled economics outrank internal sophistication or attention metrics.
intents.rationale: This is the anti-cathedral boundary that prevents a technically elaborate media machine from substituting activity for business or user outcomes.
intents.next_review_trigger: Before selecting or funding the first external commercial pilot.
unresolved_questions: The first real offer and owned-audience destination require founder selection and external authority.

intents.title: Preserve the real IdeaRefinery to WMI institutional path
intents.statement: The canonical path begins with Idea and IdeaRefinery._opportunity_from, produces OpportunityPacket and packet_to_wire, and reaches the actual WMI consumer only through the governed structural boundary; DALEOBANKS owns sensing and WMI owns strategic assessment.
intents.intended_outcome: Route evidence-bearing public opportunities into truthful commercial assessment without collapsing organ ownership or bypassing Kernel authority.
intents.rationale: The existing domain path is useful and must be hardened rather than replaced by a hand-written integration fixture.
intents.next_review_trigger: When an authenticated actual WMI intake endpoint is available for an end-to-end contract test.
unresolved_questions: The actual WMI repository/runtime is outside this repository and was intentionally not modified.

intents.title: Never remember a WMI mock as real participation
intents.statement: Every local WealthMachineClient mock result must remain permanently labeled SIMULATION, MOCK, NON_EXTERNAL, and NON_WMI_EXECUTION and must not enter institutional memory as actual WMI execution.
intents.intended_outcome: Keep simulation useful for planning without fabricating cross-organ evidence or strategic closure.
intents.rationale: The previous same-shape mock could be mistaken for real assessment; permanent provenance fields and explicit simulation status close that ambiguity.
intents.next_review_trigger: Any change to the WMI wire contract or assessment persistence path.

intents.source: DALEOBANKS Complete Master Implementation Prompt and PR #65
intents.source_location: User master prompt sections 21-38 and phases 2-10 in section 71; PR #65 architecture sections 8-17

intents.rationale: The destination is preserved, but implementing all stages before one controlled loop and real outcome would violate the anti-cathedral and stage-gate rules.
intents.next_review_trigger: The controlled shadow loop reaches its target and an authorized external evidence pilot is selected.
